Title: Public preview: Azure Data Explorer is now supported as an output for Azure Stream Analytics job

Body.Content:
Azure powered real time analytics architecture is now more powerful with native integration of Azure Data Explorer as an output for Azure Stream Analytics. With this new integration, an Azure Stream Analytics job can natively ingest the data into an Azure Data Explorer table.

Learn more about this feature.
